title: docs(qa): re-point records-forms.crud-roundtrip and record-edit-undo from the removed History tab to the record page v3 audit read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D69GmjeuSJCh6knnX8McNVE)_

Fixes #27654

domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwDe31dqqFpKC87EUg (card thread)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：清单条目 `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` 与 `records-forms.record-edit-undo` 里还让巡检去点 History 标签页的步骤和断言，改指向记录页 v3 的真实形态：记录页的 `sys_audit_log` 读取，结果在时间线「变更」筛选里（按宽度分层定位）。另改了 showcase 账户对象上一行注释。
- 为什么改：记录页 v3（#27055）在所有宽度下都没有 History 标签页，旧步骤让每轮巡检多出假红。
- 风险与回滚：只动一份清单 JSON 和一行注释，无产品行为变化。回滚即 revert。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Same shape as #27651 gave `records-forms.field-history-tracking`. No product code.

- **`records-forms.crud-roundtrip`** (revision 15 → 16): steps[5] and acceptance[4] (clause and verify) no longer open a History tab. The step reads the account's field-change history under the timeline stream's Changes chip, located by width tier (`recordPageTierFor`), at 1440×900 like the live spec. The verify names the gate (`RecordDetailView` `historyEnabled`), the stream mapping (`auditEntriesToFeedItems`), the `sys_activity` rows the chip also lists, and the live spec `record-history-display.spec.ts`. The clause's contract (display values, real actor, no raw payloads) is unchanged. History row added.
- **`records-forms.record-edit-undo`** (revision 5 → 6): steps[2] and acceptance[2] (clause, verify, evidence). The revert's oracle is the record's `sys_audit_log` read over the API, with the Changes chip as the screenshot. The item stays `blocked(fixture)`. History row added.
- **`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/account.object.ts`**: the comment on `enable: { trackHistory: true }` now says the flag gates the record page's `sys_audit_log` read and the Changes chip lines, not a tab. **Comment only, no behaviour.** This file is outside `domain:devx`; it is declared here under triage's cross-domain grant (#27654, comment 6503022089).

## Why

Record page v3 (#27055) draws no History tab at any width (`buildDefaultTabs` emits Details / Timeline / Related / Approvals; `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` asserts it). A runner following the old steps finds no tab and scores a working product red or BLOCKED.

## Verification

- `git grep -n -i 'history tab' -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas examples/app-showcase`, history rows excluded: 0 hits in this card's locations. Two hits remain, both in `records-forms.field-history-tracking` (steps[3] and acceptance[2].verify, landed by #27651); they are negations ("Record page v3 has no History tab", "Nor is a History tab"), not instructions, and that item is outside this card's file surface. The new text here avoids the literal phrase.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 40 commands at the committed head. 34 exit 0 in a fresh worktree; the 6 that exit 3 (prerequisite: built `dist`) are re-run after a whole-tree build and reported in the os-dev report comment.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Changeset: none (`skip-changeset`): docs and an example comment, nothing publishes.
